name: Low Shoulder
spec: yellow diamond with black legend LOW SHOULDER
meaning: The shoulder is lower than the road; do not drift off the edge.

snippets.back: A SOFT SHOULDER sign warns that the roadside is soft, so stay on the pavement.
Condition plates refuse tall rigs at low spans, flag gravel, soft shoulders, slick bends, waterable dips, tight and single-file bridges, and gear-dropping hills.
Keep the wheel top at or below shoulder height, plant your heel to pivot between pedals, and let shorter drivers add a cushion or pedal extenders to hold the ten-inch gap.
The top of the steering wheel should stay at or below shoulder height and below the chin.
Poorly maintained roads may present potholes, ruts and shoulder drop-offs that create driving hazards.
A Soft Shoulder warning indicates hazardous soft dirt beside the paved roadway.
When steering around a hazard, avoid braking during the turn if possible, particularly when entering a soft shoulder.
A Slippery When Wet sign warns of a road that gets unusually slick in wet weather, and a Soft Shoulder sign means do not drive off the pavement.

result.summary: No snippet names or describes a LOW SHOULDER sign; references are to SOFT SHOULDER or generic shoulder drop-offs/body height.
